gpu_tip: ~35GB total, and that number barely moves with context length — the sliding-window/GQA combo keeps the cache small even at the full 131K window. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060 Ti) plus ~32GB of DDR5 system RAM covers it.
mac_tip: Needs ~35GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) comfortably.
